notes: Warmth is exceptional: 'the kind of crying that is not really about anything you can fix' and 'trusting way only sleeping children are heavy' are precisely the intimate, specific observations that earn a 5. The arc is textbook — fog/setting, effort/crying, doubt/summit, revelation/ferns, coda — and every paragraph serves the shape. The Russian is genuinely native-register: 'жила по своим правилам', 'та доверчивая тяжесть', 'я ошибалась насчёт всего дня' are idiomatic and emotionally exact, not calques. Photo selection is plausible (7 indices, distributed 0–11), though without knowing what photos 1, 3, 6, 8, 10 depict it is impossible to confirm the descent/fern beat is covered, hence 4.0 rather than 5.0. Many narrative details (the switchbacks, the strap line, the 600m elevation, the April fern coils) are well-motivated expansions but have no grounding in the seed text and are correctly marked UNSUPPORTED.
